name: SnipBook
tagline: Simple salon bookings that just work
summary: SnipBook is a lightweight booking app for hair salons where customers select a service and time, while the salon views a daily schedule and marks appointments as done.
problem: Independent salons struggle with missed calls, double-bookings, and messy calendars. Owners need a simple way for clients to self-book and a clear daily view to track and complete appointments.

personas.name: Salon Owner
personas.goal: Fill the calendar, avoid double-bookings, and quickly mark appointments as completed.

personas.name: Stylist
personas.goal: See my day at a glance and know which services and clients are next.

personas.name: Customer
personas.goal: Book a service at a convenient time in seconds and receive confirmation.

features.name: Customer self-booking by service and time
Daily calendar view for the salon
Prevent double-booking per staff and time slot
Basic customer profile capture (name, phone, email)
Notes on appointments for special requests

stories.want: to pick a service and available time slot
stories.so: I can book without calling the salon
acceptance: I can see available time slots for my chosen service
Booking confirms instantly if the slot is free
I receive a confirmation with date, time, and service

stories.want: to view today's appointments in a single calendar
stories.so: I can prepare and manage the day efficiently
acceptance: I can filter by staff member
Appointments show customer name, service, and time
Past times are visually distinct from future slots

stories.want: to mark an appointment as completed
stories.so: the schedule stays accurate and metrics are tracked
acceptance: I can change status from booked to completed

stories.want: to prevent double-booking of the same staff
stories.so: no two appointments overlap for a stylist
acceptance: Overlapping bookings for the same staff are blocked
User receives a clear error message with alternatives
Calendar updates reflect the reserved time instantly

stories.want: to manage services with duration and price
stories.so: customers can book accurately and pricing is clear
acceptance: I can add, edit, deactivate services
Price is shown to customers during booking

stories.want: to reschedule or cancel my appointment
stories.so: I can adjust plans without calling
acceptance: I can select a new available time for the same service

metrics: Calendar utilization rate (booked hours / available hours)
